title: Data Structures & Algorithms in Depth
description: Crack technical interviews with optimal Big-O complexity solutions in Trees, Graphs, Dynamic Programming & Heaps.
overview: Master fundamental data structures and algorithmic paradigms required for top-tier software engineering roles.
learningOutcomes: Analyze time and space complexity using Big-O notation
Implement Trees, Graphs, Tries, Heaps, and Hash Tables from scratch
Solve Dynamic Programming problems with memoization & tabulation
Master Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS) graph traversals

topics.title: Binary Tree Traversals (In-order, Pre-order, Post-order)
topics.summary: Learn recursive and iterative tree traversal strategies with time O(N) and space O(H) complexity analysis.
cheatSheet: In-order traversal on a BST yields sorted elements.
Time Complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of tree nodes.
Space Complexity: O(H) stack call depth where H is tree height.
